tldr: US stock indices declined, and volatility rose, amidst reports of global bond yields impacting stocks and increasing oil prices.
The Supreme Court blocked the Trump administration's proposed restrictions on mail-in voting for the upcoming midterm elections.
NATO countries reported escalating "reckless and dangerous" Russian actions, including military encounters in the Baltic Sea and an explosive drone incident over Lithuania.

market.why: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite both closed lower. This occurred as global bond market conditions were reported to be unsettling stocks, alongside rising crude oil prices due to a Saudi pipeline outage and Houthi strikes.

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield saw a marginal decrease. The provided articles do not offer a specific explanation for this particular daily movement, although one article noted global bond yields hitting 2008 highs generally.

vix.why: The VIX, a measure of market volatility, increased. This rise occurred as major stock indices experienced declines and market sentiment was reportedly unsettled by bond market movements.

watchlist.read: Within 4% of its 1-month low. Big session: down 17.0% in a day.

mortgage.why: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate increased over the past week. Mortgage rates typically follow the direction of the 10-year Treasury yield over several days; while the 10-year yield saw a slight daily decrease, the broader context of bond market movements influenced the weekly mortgage rate.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: This document contains final regulations regarding the deduction for certain taxpayers for an amount up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.
policy_upcoming.effect: You can deduct up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

tech.summary: Meta introduced new Meta One subscriptions, bundling its standalone app subscriptions with additional AI usage, now available globally in various tiers for individuals, creators, and businesses.
OpenAI reportedly acquired smartphone camera maker Glass Imaging for $300 million and is paying to create more biological data to enhance its AI models.
SimpliSafe launched its new Video Doorbell Series 2, which integrates AI analysis with live agents to detect and proactively respond to potential threats at the front door.

world.summary: NATO allies, including Denmark and Lithuania, reported "reckless and dangerous" Russian behavior, with a Russian warship firing flares at a Danish helicopter in the Baltic Sea and an Italian jet shooting down an explosive drone over Lithuania.
A public inquiry found that three babies might have survived if a UK hospital had taken earlier action on concerns regarding nurse Lucy Letby.
Ash emissions from Mount Etna led to the suspension of all flights at one of Sicily's busiest airports until Tuesday night.
A crucial oil pipeline was shut down due to significant damage, with experts estimating that this could reduce global oil supplies by as much as 3.6 million barrels per day.

us.summary: The Supreme Court rejected the Trump administration's request to implement new mail-in voting restrictions for the midterm general election.
The Trump administration's Environmental Protection Agency repealed limits on climate-warming pollution from the nation's fossil fuel power plants.

A federal judge blocked the Trump administration's rule that would have limited how long foreign students and journalists could remain in the US without applying for extensions, a day before it was set to take effect.

science.summary: A new study indicates that short bursts of vigorous physical movement can contribute to longevity, even if individuals do not meet daily step goals.
Pennsylvania announced its third measles-related death in under three weeks, involving an unvaccinated 40-year-old woman.
